entities.summary: Theeraphol Samranklang, known professionally as Veeraphol Sahaprom or mononymously as Veeraphol, is a Thai retired professional Muay Thai fighter and professional boxer. A three-division Rajadamnern Stadium champion as well as a WBC and WBA bantamweight champion in boxing, he is widely regarded as one of the greatest Muay Thai fighters of all time and also one of the greatest western-style boxers from Thailand. Nicknamed "The Stoic Tiger" or "Deathmask", he was known for never changing his expression when throwing punches. He is also known for his precise jab.
